normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool*Pool heating is available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Pet-friendly- Fire Pit- 6 adult bikes- Garage (left side only)- Propane grill- Outdoor TVs on each balcony and in backyard- Community pool- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Escape to Belle Vue at Cypress Breeze for a delightful Blue Mountain Beach group or family vacation. This pet-friendly home, located across from the community pool, boasts 6 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and sleeps up to 25 guests. Native blue lupine flowers, dune lakes, local artist studios, and white-sand beaches define this stretch of the Emerald Coast. Imagine peaceful days lounging by the private pool, barbecuing on the deck, and sipping cocktails on the top-level balcony.Sunlight fills the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen spaces found on the main level. A plush sectional, electric fireplace, 65” Smart TV, and Sonos sound system invite guests to enjoy a chill night of entertainment in the living space. The chef’s kitchen includes Z-line appliances and a 4-stool breakfast bar for brunches and pre-dinner cocktails. Choose the table for 10 inside or dine alfresco on the screened porch with a propane grill, 8-top table, patio chairs, and a TV. A second charming balcony is by the kitchen. At evening’s end, retire to the lovely primary bedroom with a king bed, Smart TV, private bathroom, and balcony access. Venture downstairs to find a shimmering private pool, 6-person patio table, and a firepit surrounded by seating in the enclosed backyard. The level hosts 2 beautiful guest bedrooms with Smart TVs and pool access. The first guest bedroom has a full-over-full bunk bed and a king bed, while the second has a queen bed.On the third floor, an airy lounge equipped with 1 twin and 1 queen sleeper sofas, a Smart TV, Sonos soundbar, and a wet bar connects to a second, furnished screened-in deck. There are 2 guest bedrooms, each with a king bed and Smart TV alongside 1 bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 1 twin trundle. A stacked washer and dryer completes the floor.Experience a luxury Blue Mountain Beach retreat at Belle Vue at Cypress Breeze. Easily explore with parking for 6 vehicles—plus 6 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Ed Walline Beach Access is a 3-minute drive away at the end of South County Highway 393. Book this gorgeous home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 25):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Full-over-Full Bunk Bed - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds and Twin Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living/Sleeping Area: Bonus Room with Full and Twin Sleeper Sofas*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs, for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax. Pets must be kept off the furniture.*Per HOA guidelines, Pitbulls, Staffordshire terriers, Rotweilers, and Doberman pinchers are prohibited at this property.
